decisions.reason: After several years without clear continued visibility, this narrow plugin likely falls below aspiration levels relative to the firm's stronger core services and newer development options, so management would reallocate resources.

The ERP interface plugin still fits the firm's end-to-end webshop and multichannel positioning, and its complementarities with client projects justify retention unless performance clearly undercuts aspirations.

This reporting plugin is close to the core offer but appears less central and, after extended uncertainty, a behavioral-theory management would likely stop carrying it if results have not proven themselves against aspirations.
